name: @adsaver-labs/wix-blog-cli
description: Safety-first Wix Blog CLI for draft creation, verification, approval-gated publishing, and public readback checks.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const cp=require('child_process');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(d,e.name)):path.join(d,e.name));for(const f of ['bin/wix-blog.js',...walk('src').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.js')),'tests/unit.js']) cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'});cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['tests/unit.js'],{stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run smoke

author: AdSaver Labs
